meta_data.base_class: Explore the applications of nanomaterials in different <technological fields> - refers to various areas where nanomaterials can be applied, such as solar, medical, textile, packaging, cosmetic, and automotive technologies.

tool_template.name: NanoMaterialInsights_<class>
tool_template.description: Provide insights into the application of nanomaterials in <class>.

region_focus.description: Geographical region to focus the analysis on for <class>.

detailed_report.description: Whether to provide a detailed report on nanomaterials in <class>.

language.description: Preferred language for the report on <class>.

application_scope.description: Specifies the scope of application of nanomaterials within <class>, such as enhancement, efficiency, or innovation.

impact_assessment.description: Indicates whether to include an assessment of the environmental and economic impact of nanomaterial use in <class>.

innovation_index.description: A numeric index representing the level of innovation in applying nanomaterials within <class>, on a scale from 1 to 10.

timeframe.description: Defines the timeframe for analyzing developments in nanomaterial applications in <class>, such as 'current trends' or 'future projections'.

regulatory_compliance.description: Whether to include information on regulatory compliance and standards related to nanomaterials in <class>.
